data.name: Ameera
data.gender_notes: Ameera is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'amīr', meaning 'commander' or 'ruler'. In Islamic tradition, Ameera is a name given to girls, symbolizing their inner strength and leadership qualities. The name Ameera carries the meaning “Princess, Ruler” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ameera usually hope their child will grow to embody princess, ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ameera represents the qualities of a strong, noble and courageous leader. It is a name for those who wish to inspire and lead others, and be remembered as a true princess or commander in their community or family.
data.etymology: Ameera belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Princess, Ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ameera total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: أميرة
in_arabic.meaning: أميرة تعني صاحبة الجلال و العزة و المكانة الرفيعة
in_arabic.long_meaning: أميرة هي كلمة مشتقة من أمارة، وتعني صاحبة الجلال و العزة و المكانة الرفيعة. و هي من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني القيادة و الرئاسة. وردت في القرآن الكريم عدة مرات، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَمُلكِ أُميرٍ' (الأنفال: 41).

in_urdu.name: امیرہ
in_urdu.meaning: امیرہ یعنی عزت والی، جلیلہ، اعلیٰ مقام رکھنے والی
in_urdu.long_meaning: امیرہ نام عربی زبان کے 'أميرة' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے عزت والی، جلیلہ، اعلیٰ مقام رکھنے والی۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں اہم مقام رکھتا ہے، خاص طور پر قرآن مجید میں جہاں یہ اعزاز اور عظمت کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अमीरा
in_hindi.meaning: अमीरा का अर्थ है उच्च पद वाली, सम्मानित और प्रतिष्ठित
in_hindi.long_meaning: अमीरा नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है उच्च पद वाली, सम्मानित और प्रतिष्ठित। इस नाम का इस्लामी संस्कृति में विशेष महत्व है, और यह नाम अक्सर उच्च दर्जा और गरिमा की प्रतीक के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है।

in_english.name: Ameera
in_english.meaning: Ameera means a high-ranking woman, noble, and respected
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ameera is derived from the Arabic root 'أمير' (amir), which means 'prince' or 'commander'. In the context of female names, Ameera signifies a high-ranking woman, noble, and respected. This name appears in various forms throughout Islamic history and literature, reflecting its association with leadership, dignity, and nobility. The Quran mentions similar terms, highlighting the importance of noble character and leadership qualities.
